scope: A5 only; preserve frozen A4 implementation and results
identity_gate: Every capital fact must exactly match instrument, ex date, cash, stock-dividend ratio and capital-reserve ratio; required face values must be evidenced and finite
source_gate: Every referenced original is SHA256 checked; a reviewed original issuer PDF with HTTPS URL and page reference is required
face_value_gate: No default face value. Nonexempt capital face must equal the evidenced delivered capital ratio times the evidenced share face value
cash_gate: Cash must cover the whole maximum reserve, including any stock dividend. Insufficient or zero cash blocks the event without changing it
classification_gate: Unresolved source classification may only use an explicit conservative upper-bound fact with evidenced nominal face; it remains unresolved in the report and is never asserted taxable or exempt
exempt_gate: Individually verified share-premium source or issuer exemption statement; separately report an implemented complete personal-tax schedule inference when short-month total tax equals 20% of actual cash to the issuer six decimal places per ten shares, stock dividend is zero, and the reserve subaccount remains unidentified. Neither path exempts cash or stock dividends
timing: Reserve at the existing cash-entitlement/payment events. This is a research cost upper bound, not an exact brokerage withholding-date simulation
sidecar: Keep evidenced capital face, source classifications, unresolved keys, tax arithmetic, receipts and implementation/spec SHA in the A5 accounting report
